name: agent-docs
description: Scaffolds a progressive-disclosure agent doc entry point (_AGENTS.md + AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md + docs/) in any project that lacks one.

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold a progressive-disclosure agent doc entry point in any project.
interface.longDescription: On SessionStart, checks the project root for _AGENTS.md and, when missing, creates _AGENTS.md (single source of truth), thin AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md pointers, and the docs/ set referenced by its index table. The hook is idempotent and injects a short [project-init] note instead of dumping the repository into context. Requires bash 3.2+ and POSIX userland; set AGENT_DOCS_DISABLE=1 to opt out.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold the agent doc entry point for this project.
